# `body_function`

Something a body as a whole can do to some degree, from what its working parts contribute (06 §6.3).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `combine` (one of `"sum"`, `"min"`, `"max"`, `"mean"` ([`Combine`](#combine)); optional): How the parts' contributions are combined. Default `sum`.

<a id="combine"></a>
### `Combine`

How a function's capacity is made from what the parts contribute (06 §6.3).

One of:

- `"sum"`: The contributions added up.
- `"min"`: The least of them: every contributor is needed.
- `"max"`: The greatest of them: any one will do.
- `"mean"`: Their average.
